headlines.text: It was 2024 when it was title-change night for the ROH World Six Man Tag Titles as Von Erichs & Rhodes vs. Undisputed Kingdom & Strong battled it out, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.84 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. For Von Erichs & Rhodes and Undisputed Kingdom & Strong, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. With Kevin Von Erich cheering ringside, Dustin Rhodes and the Von Erichs overcame Undisputed Kingdom interference and cowbell shots to win the vacant ROH World Six-Man Tag Team Titles.

Back on this day in 2022, Daniel Garcia vs. Bryan Danielson headlined Dynamite, rated 8.42 ? a genuinely great match, on an outstanding Fight for the Fallen '22 - Night 1 show that earned an overall rating of 8.46.

It was 2024 when Hologram competed under the AEW banner for the first time against The Beast Mortos, appearing on Collision, rated 7.88 ? a good, competitive contest. Making his AEW debut in a neon glowing vest, Hologram impressed the Arlington crowd in a strong showing against The Beast Mortos.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2022, when Jon Moxley vs. Rush put the AEW Interim World Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.70 ? a good, competitive contest. For Rush, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
Rewind to 2024, when Mansoor made their AEW debut, appearing on Collision, rated 6.71.

Flash back to 2022, when Thunder Rosa vs. Miyu Yamashita fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.55. It was the first title opportunity of Miyu Yamashita's career. This stood as the 30th match in AEW Women's World Title history ? a real landmark for that championship.
